record.question: Choose the word which is most opposite in meaning of the given word: Philistine
record.explanation: Answer A: cultured. A Philistine is characterized as uncultured; cultured is the direct opposite listed. Independent check: A Philistine is characterized by lack of cultural or artistic refinement; “cultured” is the direct opposite. “Educated” is not a precise synonym for cultural refinement. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cultured; https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/philistine. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
